# Data flow

The pages hold no player data. The only flow is a player choosing to email support.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  player["Player"] -->|reads| privacy["/games/privacy"]
  player -->|reads| support["/games/support"]
  support -->|player writes by choice| mail["games@awesoontechnologies.com"]
```

- No forms, accounts or analytics on the games pages.
